fields.description: Issue features extensive coverage of alleged abuses at the Miami Retreat and criticism of psychiatrist Dr. T. Earl Moore ("Torture Doctor"), including calls for grand jury and state medical board action and mention of a potential witness (Edward (Dick) Tracy). Also includes local political commentary on Florida Power & Light and municipal ownership, discussion of anti-gambling campaigns and pari-mutuel racing, Miami municipal court activity, a proposed public utilities act, a community festival announcement at Crandon Park, a warning about DDT spraying, and a Coral Way zoning dispute.
